name: Paired Fang
description: Bite with two fangs of soul force on two tracks so that the foe can guard only one.

name: Parallel Taste
description: Taste a soul along two tracks at once and read its force and its wounds together.

name: Rail Husk
description: Lay a husk along each track that eats the force of a strike running down it.

name: Dual Draught
description: Drink from both tracks and pour the drawn force into the user and one near ally.

name: Track Chain
description: Lay a chain on each track so that the foe's soul is held from two sides.

name: Crossing Bite
description: Cross both tracks inside the foe's guard and bite where they meet.

name: Convergent Devour
description: Bring both tracks to a point in the foe's soul and gorge on all that gathers there.

name: Hunger Tide
description: Send a tide of hunger down both tracks across a company and drain every soul it passes.

name: Dual Consumption
description: Consume the foe's soul along both tracks and take the whole of it into the user.

name: Convergent Appetite
description: The school's closing move that brings both tracks to one feast and takes a share that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Core Bite
description: Bite with force drawn up from the Core and take a measure of the foe's soul.

name: Core Scent
description: Catch the scent of a soul on the breath of the Core and judge its worth.

name: Husk Wrap
description: Wrap the Core in a husk of old hunger that eats the force of a strike.

name: Core Swallow
description: Swallow the drawn force into the Core in a single motion.

name: Kernel Chain
description: Chain the kernel of the foe's soul so that it cannot slip out of reach.

name: Kernel Fang
description: Drive a fang of Core hunger to the kernel of the foe's soul.

name: Kernel Cleansing
description: Eat the stain from the kernel of an ally's soul until it shines clean.

name: Kernel Siphon
description: Draw a siphon from the foe's kernel that spoils the root of his technique.

name: Kernel Devour
description: Gorge on the kernel of a soul and feed the Core with all of it.

name: Kernel Famine
description: Spread a famine of the Core that strips the kernels of a whole company.

name: Kernel Consumption
description: Absorb a soul attack into the Core and answer it by consuming the foe's kernel.

name: Heart of Hunger
description: The school's closing move that tears the heart of hunger from the Core and consumes the foe by a measure of the user's reserve.

name: Squall Bite
description: Bite on the rush of a squall and carry off a measure of the foe's soul.

name: Squall Scent
description: Read the squall for the scent of every soul it passes over.

name: Squall Husk
description: Wear a husk of squall that tears the force from a soul strike.

name: Squall Chain
description: Cast a chain of squall about the foe's soul that tightens as he strains.

name: Squall Leech
description: Set a siphon in the squall that pulls at the foe's focus.

name: Squall Spear
description: Throw a spear of squall through the guard and drink what it finds.

name: Squall Devouring
description: Blow a binding or a stain out of an ally's soul and eat it on the squall.

name: Squall Devour
description: Gorge on a foe at the heart of the squall and carry the share to the user.

name: Squall Famine
description: Spread the squall over a company so that every soul within it wastes.

name: Squall Consumption
description: Absorb the force of an attack into the squall and return it as a consuming blow.

name: Gale Devourer
description: The school's closing move that looses the full hunger of the gale on a company and takes a share scaled to the user's reserve.

name: Deep Bite
description: Bite deep into the root of the foe's soul and pull up a measure.

name: Deep Scent
description: Scent the roots of every soul in range and mark the deepest.

name: Deep Husk
description: Cover the root of the soul with a husk that eats the force of a strike.

name: Deep Chain
description: Chain the root of the foe's soul so that it cannot run.

name: Deep Siphon
description: Pull a siphon from the roots of the foe's soul and cut off his technique.

name: Deep Fang
description: Drive a fang to the root of the soul through every ward.

name: Deep Devour
description: Gorge on the root of a soul and fill the user from beneath.

name: Deep Famine
description: Spread a famine from below that starves the roots of every soul in range.

name: Deep Consumption
description: Absorb a soul attack into the root and answer by consuming the foe's own.

name: Hunger Oath Absolute
description: The school's deepest oath that binds the foe to the hunger and consumes him by a measure of the user's reserve.
